note: The closest thing in this batch to the ICP as stated. A 29-year-old full-time software engineer building a second venture, who confirmed twice he could pay $6,000 in cash and has roughly $1,000 a month spare; already lean at 141 lb and a self-measured 13% body fat, training four or more times a week, and explicitly asking for the last increment rather than a rescue — the rep summarised it accurately as 'we're looking at just how do we get that last stubborn couple percent'. The single listed miss is a technicality in the favourable direction: health is not his neglected area, it is one of his better-managed ones, so he sits past the starting point the ICP describes rather than short of it. Scored core on that basis. Worth recording for the rollup that the textbook-fit prospect did not buy, and did not decline on price — he declined on a self-imposed rule about which money may fund a soft-return purchase, after being burned by a previous big-ticket coaching programme. The stated ICP screens on income and starting point and has nothing to say about prior coaching experience, which is what actually decided this call.
